about.title: About
about.body: I hang around Ueno Park a lot and keep running into different birds. I’ve always wondered what those cute birds are called — so I made this site. The style and idea draw from AvianVisitors (theodore.net).

data.title: Data source
data.body: Bird data and how often they show up are compiled from records on eBird. Every atlas page links to the official eBird species page.

art.title: Illustrations
art.body: The cutouts use a bird-and-flower print style. They’re AI-generated from anatomy references and reviewed by hand. The page layout and interaction also take cues from AvianVisitors.
